description: Overwrite the project's Postgres with a snapshot (one is taken before every migration; list them with db action `snapshots`). Pass `snapshot_id`, or `timestamp` for the newest snapshot taken at or before it. All data written since the snapshot is lost, so the first call returns needs_approval with `error.approval.url`; after the user approves there, call again with `approval_token`. Services restart afterwards.

project.description: Project slug. Optional: defaults to rivtor.json in the working directory, else its folder name.

name: db_restore
title: Restore the database from a snapshot
